moments.title: I'm A Celeb is ON!
moments.blurb: The 26th series of I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! started on ITV on November 16th, featuring stars like Wayne Rooney, Ade Adepitan, and Joanna Page.

angles.name: Rooney in the Jungle
angles.copy: Wayne Rooney has swapped the football pitch for the jungle! How do you think he's handling those Bushtucker Trials on I'm A Celeb? #ImACeleb

angles.name: Campmates Chat
angles.copy: Who's your favourite campmate on I'm A Celeb this year? With Ade Adepitan, Joanna Page, and Claire Sweeney, there's plenty to talk about! Tune in nightly on ITV.

moments.title: Black Friday is HERE
moments.blurb: Black Friday officially falls on Friday, November 27th, but many UK retailers are already launching deals throughout 'Black Week', with Cyber Monday following on November 30th.

angles.name: Deals Alert
angles.copy: Your wallet's about to get a workout! Black Friday officially lands on November 27th, but deals are already dropping. What are you hoping to snag a bargain on this year?

angles.name: Shopping Weekend
angles.copy: It's almost Black Friday weekend! Get ready for the biggest shopping event of the year, running right through to Cyber Monday on November 30th. Are you a planner or a last-minute shopper?

moments.title: Premier League Showdown: Liverpool vs Man Utd
moments.blurb: One of the biggest fixtures in English football, Liverpool face rivals Manchester United in the Premier League on Sunday, November 22nd, kicking off at 4:30 PM GMT on Sky Sports.

angles.name: Big Game Build-up
angles.copy: It's the ultimate rivalry this Sunday! Liverpool host Manchester United at Anfield. Who are you backing to win this Premier League clash?

angles.name: Match Day Excitement
angles.copy: Get ready for a Super Sunday of football! Liverpool vs Manchester United, 4:30 PM GMT on Sky Sports. Where will you be watching?

moments.title: Title Clash: Arsenal vs Man City
moments.blurb: The Premier League concludes November with a massive clash as Arsenal host Manchester City on Sunday, November 29th, with a 4:30 PM GMT kick-off on Sky Sports.

angles.name: Top of the Table Battle
angles.copy: A huge Premier League encounter on November 29th! Arsenal take on Manchester City in a game that could shape the title race. Who's your money on?

angles.name: Super Sunday Football
angles.copy: Don't miss Arsenal vs Man City next Sunday at 4:30 PM GMT on Sky Sports. The Gunners and Citizens go head-to-head!

moments.title: London's Christmas Lights Aglow
moments.blurb: Central London is now dazzling with Christmas lights, with many famous displays including Carnaby Street, Regent Street, Oxford Street, Bond Street, and Covent Garden having already switched on.

angles.name: Festive Glow
angles.copy: London is officially sparkling! The Christmas lights are now on across the West End, bringing that festive magic to the city. Which display is your favourite?

angles.name: Winter Wonderland Open
angles.copy: Hyde Park Winter Wonderland is also open, adding to the festive cheer in London! Who's heading there this weekend?

moments.title: Jamie Miller Holds UK No.1
moments.blurb: Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' continues its impressive run, holding the Official UK Singles Chart Number 1 spot for an 11th consecutive week (as of November 7th/11th).

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still at the top! Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' has held the UK Number 1 for an incredible 11 weeks. What a track!

angles.name: Pop Dominance
angles.copy: Jamie Miller dominating the Official Singles Chart with 'Babydoll'. Is it one of your most-played songs right now?

moments.title: Queens of the Stone Age Top Album Chart
moments.blurb: Queens of the Stone Age have landed the UK Official Albums Chart Number 1 spot with their new record 'Perfecth' (as of November 7th).

angles.name: Rock Reign
angles.copy: Queens of the Stone Age are officially Number 1 on the UK Albums Chart with 'Perfecth'! Are you spinning their new album?

angles.name: New Album Buzz
angles.copy: Huge congratulations to Queens of the Stone Age on their chart-topping album 'Perfecth'! What's your favourite track from it?

moments.title: Strictly Christmas Special Cast Revealed
moments.blurb: Angela Rippon, Ashley Roberts, Kimberley Walsh, and Lewis Cope have been confirmed to return for the 'Strictly Come Dancing' 2026 Christmas Special.

angles.name: Strictly Stars Return
angles.copy: Angela Rippon and Ashley Roberts are back for the Strictly Christmas Special! Who else are you hoping to see return to the dancefloor?

angles.name: Festive Glitterball
angles.copy: Kimberley Walsh and Lewis Cope join the line-up for the Strictly Come Dancing Christmas Special! We can't wait to see them compete for the festive Glitterball!

moments.title: Enter Shikari at Alexandra Palace
moments.blurb: British rock band Enter Shikari are playing two nights at London's Alexandra Palace, tonight (November 20th) and tomorrow (November 21st).

angles.name: Shikari Live
angles.copy: Enter Shikari are taking over Alexandra Palace tonight and tomorrow! Who's heading to see them live in London?

angles.name: London Gigs
angles.copy: Two nights of Enter Shikari at Ally Pally! If you're going, get ready for an epic show!

moments.title: The Script Play The O2
moments.blurb: Irish rock band The Script will play a major show at The O2 Arena in London on Saturday, November 21st.

angles.name: The Script Live
angles.copy: The Script are bringing their hits to The O2 in London tomorrow! Who's excited for a night of anthems?

angles.name: Weekend Gigs
angles.copy: Catch The Script at London's O2 Arena this Saturday! Are you going to be there?

moments.title: Jungle's Two Nights at The O2
moments.blurb: Electronic music collective Jungle will perform two nights at The O2 Arena in London on Tuesday, November 24th and Wednesday, November 25th.

angles.name: Jungle Groove
angles.copy: Jungle are set for two huge nights at The O2 next week! Get ready to move to their incredible sound.

angles.name: London Dance
angles.copy: Who's catching Jungle live at The O2 on Nov 24th or 25th? It's going to be an unmissable show!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Björk!

angles.name: Björk's Day
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 61st birthday to the incomparable Björk tomorrow! What's your all-time favourite track from her?

angles.name: Music Icon
angles.copy: Happy Birthday to the legendary Björk, turning 61 tomorrow! An artist who continually pushes boundaries.

moments.title: Happy 41st to Carly Rae Jepsen

angles.name: Pop Princess

angles.name: Birthday Pop
angles.copy: Happy 41st Birthday to the incredible Carly Rae Jepsen tomorrow! What's your favourite song from her?

angles.name: Miley's Birthday
angles.copy: Sending big birthday wishes to Miley Cyrus, who turns 34 on Monday! What's your favourite era of her music?

angles.name: Pop Rock Star
angles.copy: Happy 34th Birthday to the one and only Miley Cyrus on November 23rd! From 'Hannah Montana' to rock icon, she's done it all.

angles.name: Birthday Vibes
angles.copy: Happy 51st Birthday to DJ Khaled this Thursday! Get ready to celebrate with some of his biggest tracks.
